correctness.rationale: For any n the endpoint order is a uniform perfect matching. M>=k and N>=l forbid pairs inside first k and last l rank blocks; splitting pair types into h cross-block, two middle classes and z middle internal pairs gives the stated finite sum. Marginal product follows by sequential pair revelation. Uniform-coordinate corner-square avoidance gives P(T>a,W>b)=(1-a^2-b^2)^n; exact Bin(n-1,2t/(1+t)) conditional law proves M-2nT=o_L2(sqrt n) and reflected N. Subgaussian survival tails yield moment and covariance convergence. A standalone exact-rational verifier exhaustively checks n<=7 and further finite identities, not a surrogate for the infinite proof.
